title: TripAdvisor Hotels Scraper
description: Extract hotel listings from TripAdvisor Hotels destination URLs with availability, occupancy, sorting, and paginated output.

startUrls.title: TripAdvisor Hotels URLs
startUrls.description: One or more TripAdvisor Hotels destination/listing URLs. Best format contains -g<geoId>- in the URL.

destination.title: Destination geo ID
destination.description: Optional TripAdvisor destination geo ID. Paste digits only, for example 293974. When supplied, it overrides the geo ID in the URL; leave empty to use each URL's destination.

checkInDate.title: Check-in date
checkInDate.description: Optional stay check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use with checkOutDate to apply availability pricing context.

checkOutDate.title: Check-out date
checkOutDate.description: Optional stay check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It must be after checkInDate.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Optional number of rooms used for availability and pricing context.

guests.title: Guests
guests.description: Optional number of adult guests used for availability and pricing context.

sorting.title: Sorting
sorting.description: Order hotel results using a TripAdvisor-supported sort mode.

results_wanted.title: Maximum listings
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of hotel listings to save across all input URLs.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages per URL
max_pages.description: Safety cap for pagination per source URL.
